Hi team,

Putting this thread together to align on Novapulse's upcoming expansion and whether we can move their pipeline item to a commit for Q3 billing. This is a pre-commit "preflight" to make sure Sales, CS and Finance have the same expectations.

Quick context: Novapulse has signaled intent to purchase an expansion bundle (~+120 seats, additional embeddings) with an expected start date in July. They're asking for a 10% promotional credit and a compressed legal timeline.

What I need from everyone before we mark any portion as committed: 
- Confirm the expected start date and pilot scope (Tessa / Elena)
- Finance view on recognition risk & recommended commit level (Marcus)
- Any procurement/legal blockers and expected turnaround (Rishi)

Please see the attached MAPlist (Novapulse_MAPlist.xlsx) for accounts / product mapping and current usage signals.

Proposed next steps:
1) Tessa: confirm ARR math + target activation date by EOD tomorrow (4/20)
2) Marcus: high-level guidance on commit percentage by EOD Fri (4/23)
3) Monica: I'll coordinate an ops/cs readiness call for next week if we look good

Thanks —
Monica

Thanks for the details. Quick finance perspective:

- Recognition risk: moderate. We treat expansions that have a firm start date and an approved PO/SOW as low risk; conditional on procurement signing by 6/10, we can treat up to 70% of the ARR as committed for SaaS forecasting. Remaining 30% we hold as upside until activation.
- Promo credit: a one-time 10% credit can be applied to the first invoice without material forecasting impact, but we should mark it in the deal notes so ARR math reflects net first-year cash.
- In practice I recommend the following: mark 70% committed (1.4M of the 2M) for the rollout on July 1, with the final 30% staged as backlog contingent on activation and SOW signature.

Procurement and legal timing: if Novapulse can deliver a signed SOW by 6/10, we will schedule revenue recognition. If SOW slips past 6/20 we should re-evaluate and push to backlog.

Rishi — please confirm if the 10% credit needs additional approval from the pricing desk or if we can approve at the AE level.

I'll drop a short note into the HubSpot deal and update the forecast if you confirm.

-Marcus
Marcus Lin
Director, Revenue Finance, Redwood Inference
